items.how: Every Chinese page says the weighting class as 凡给每样东西（每个所列之物）一个大于零的权重、再把权重相加的计法, the plain form on the screen and the listed form where the theorem is stated. 有所值的计法 is gone from all of them. The class's other names inside a page (正加权 in USES.zh and USES-EXAMPLES.zh) became 这类计法 / 这样的计法. The overview's technical paragraph keeps 赋权 under its own heading 每一个可加的正赋权所共有的.

On the fronts it reads 按扩大排序，在生命自身的关切之外不另加前提：在延续条件成立之处，这一关切已经这样排序 (the screen keeps its pinned 也…因为 form). The Chinese glossary's widening row now joins it with 而, not 所以. The C row and the overview carry 本论不再把 C 当作伦理的第二个根基；这个名字留给某些定理所取的这一要求. The overview carries 其证明只在生命自身的立场上用到延续条件.

生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明；在证明中它是假设；模型中的持存只是对所择者的过滤，并不形成次序（07 §4.9）, on the screen, one page, USES, the overview, the glossary, 06 and the opening's notes. No Chinese page says 已论证 of it. The overview and 06 say the condition and self-concern 表示本论之中的一种范围与次序的一种性质；作为假设…不凌驾于生灭变化之上；诸形成是否、如何持有它们，是开放的目标. 持守 as the name for holding such an order is gone, except in the praised heading 有谁必须持守延续条件吗.

依存若只沿一个方向，对自身延续的关切未必把依存于它的那些也算进来 everywhere. The lake reads 保住渔民自身的延续，并不要求保住贻贝床. The overview adds that self-concern does not exclude them either (increasingInOwn_of_increasing). Where 算进来 piled up, the glossary and overview now say 这一关切之中，没有什么要求计入它们的损失.

items.item: H5 (C a requirement; 广者居上)
items.how: C is 对一种次序的一项要求 in the glossary, the overview, 06, the one page's join row and the examples. 广者居上 is used in 06, the glossary and the dossiers. The glossary row keeps 旧名以广为愈（至 2026 年 11 月 9 日） once, and 06 §7.3 keeps the 中华本's old name as history, with the dated withdrawal. On the one page, the self-concern sentence no longer uses C's defining phrase.

No Chinese page glosses the one-center result with 如在标有日期的诸发生之间. The overview, USES and the glossary say 在一个无环的关系上，若它成立，每一个立场都有同一个中心. The opening's note follows its English ('holds only where every standpoint has the same center'), which is equivalent. Closure is said as 关系闭合 with 跨越所有步来读, glossed once per page as 把不同时刻的影响合在一起看、不要求各环节按时间先后衔接. Nothing is said of what holds in time.
沿“受影响”这一关系，从每个中心都能到达一切, and 若把从一个立场看有意义的，读作该立场之中心所能到达的范围，延续条件…在这种读法下说的正是这个，根上称之为续无外. 与之一同延续 and 别无他物 are on no Chinese front or glossary row.
因而从某一步起都不再容纳任何东西 on the screen and one page, and 容纳终会止息 in USES, the overview and the opening's notes. 终会停止容纳 is gone.
这两项结果可以直接组合，只是没有一条定理单独陈述这一组合 on every page. The opening's note no longer says 尚无一条定理 (a gap), and 合成 became 组合 throughout the fronts.

伦理从延续中生出 on every Chinese page, and now in 06 as well. The overview says “生出”既不指一个推导，也不指一个已表明的发展, then what is shown, offered and open. The screen and one page carry the same three through their how-far sentences.

1: 在那里 opens no sentence (the screen's test forbids it). 2: 依存于它 / 依存于自己者; the overview's 依存于自身者 was fixed here. 3: 同时提出的. 4: the one page has 在自身所续者之外, and the overview keeps 相续, which is the glossary's term for 'line' there. 5: 持存, not 持续, in the glossary and overview. 6: 从某一步起都不再容纳任何东西. 7: everything praised is kept, except 每一个中心沿关系所及的范围之外，别无他物 and 它不是第二个前提, which H7 and H2 replace deliberately.

1: self-concern defined once as 一种排序性质; 持守…次序 is gone from USES-EXAMPLES.zh and the opening's [^own] note too. 2: the additive class, and C's history sentence. 3: 从每个中心都能到达一切. 4: closure glossed as reading times together, now with the condition first. 5: 不再容纳 / 终会止息; 容纳 is defined in the one page's case paragraph and not re-glossed on the screen, kept deliberately as the glossary term. 6: 尚未表明 with 在证明中它是假设. 7: 未必…算进来 and the lake sentence. 8: 把“哪些延续有意义”留作自由参数. 9: 只证明了这一个方向 on the fronts and now in the opening's notes too, with 单向 kept for one-way dependence. 10: 把排序结果所预设的范围与次序说清楚; 较短的读法; 诸立场在自身所续者之外. 即更多的未来 is kept as the brief asks; the one page's added restatement after it is trimmed.
